title: Matoi: Selective Revalidation of Consequence Evidence for Agent Authorization
abstract: arXiv:2610.21394v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Matoi separates reusable consequence evidence from current execution authority and durable occurrence history. Its finite query-aware contract covers branches, ordered collections and negative lookups. A consumer reuses only its own checked evidence whose observations remain valid; signed requests, live grants, quota and uncertain outcomes remain separate obligations. Conditional correctness arguments distinguish locally serialized claims from nontransactional remote effects. Two studies strengthen cost attribution and domain evaluation. A 1,440-cell matched-wire study repeats 144 authored inputs. With compact input bytes identical, reuse reduces complete lifecycle cost by 3.49 percent in JS and 1.79 percent in Python. Combined representation/reuse reductions against full proof are 10.87 and 16.53 percent; five of twelve family intervals for the matched comparison cross one in each language. A prospectively frozen AgentDojo Banking map

translated_title: Matoi：面向智能体授权的结果证据选择性重验证
translated_abstract: Matoi 将可复用的结果证据与当前执行权限以及持久的发生历史分离开来。其有限的查询感知契约涵盖分支、有序集合和否定查找。消费者仅复用其自身的、且观察结果仍然有效的已核验证据；签名请求、实时授权、配额和不确定结果仍作为单独的义务处理。条件正确性论证区分了本地序列化声明与非事务性远程效果。两项研究加强了成本归因和领域评估。一项包含 1440 个单元格的匹配线路研究重复了 144 个编写的输入。在压缩输入字节相同的情况下，复用使完整生命周期成本在 JavaScript 中降低 3.49%，在 Python 中降低 1.79%。相对于完整证明，表示/复用组合的成本降低分别为 10.87% 和 16.53%；匹配比较的十二个家族区间中有五个在每种语言中跨过 1。一项前瞻性冻结的 AgentDojo Banking 映射
tldr: Matoi 提出了一种智能体授权机制，通过将可复用的结果证据与执行权限和发生历史分离并进行选择性重验证，在保证条件正确性的前提下使完整生命周期成本在 JS 和 Python 中分别降低 3.49% 和 1.79%。
en_tdlr: Matoi proposes an agent authorization mechanism that selectively revalidates reusable consequence evidence while separating it from execution authority and occurrence history, reducing full lifecycle costs by 3.49% in JS and 1.79% in Python while preserving conditional correctness.
